label: arbitrary
contract: The first delay is base itself; the multiplier first applies to the second delay.
visible_check:
from retries import retry_delays
for args, want in (((3, 2, 3, 100), [2, 6, 18]), ((4, 0.5, 2, 60), [0.5, 1, 2, 4])):
    got = retry_delays(*args)
    assert got == want, (args, got)
heldout_check:
from retries import retry_delays
for args, want in (((3, 5, 2, 1000), [5, 10, 20]), ((4, 0.25, 4, 500), [0.25, 1, 4, 16])):
    got = retry_delays(*args)
    assert got == want, (args, got)

label: preserve
contract: A later delay that would grow past max_delay equals max_delay instead.
visible_check:
from retries import retry_delays
for args in ((8, 1, 2, 10), (7, 1.5, 3, 20)):
    got = retry_delays(*args)
    cap = args[3]
    assert max(got) == cap and got[-1] == cap, (args, got)
heldout_check:
from retries import retry_delays
for args in ((8, 3, 2, 40), (6, 0.5, 4, 25)):
    got = retry_delays(*args)
    cap = args[3]
    assert max(got) == cap and got[-1] == cap, (args, got)

label: inferable
contract: With valid arguments, a schedule of thousands of retries returns all of its delays without an overflow error.
visible_check:
from retries import retry_delays
for args in ((1200, 1, 2.0, 30), (1100, 0.5, 2, 60)):
    got = retry_delays(*args)
    assert len(got) == args[0] and max(got) <= args[3] and got[-1] == got[-2] > 0, (args, got[-3:])
heldout_check:
from retries import retry_delays
for args in ((2000, 3, 1.5, 120), (1300, 0.25, 3, 45)):
    got = retry_delays(*args)
    assert len(got) == args[0] and max(got) <= args[3] and got[-1] == got[-2] > 0, (args, got[-3:])
